title: 1.2 Dalton's Atomic Theory and the Modern Atomic Theory
description: Postulates of Dalton's atomic theory and modern atomic theory

questions.question: Which ancient Greek philosopher proposed that dividing matter into smaller pieces eventually produces tiny, indestructible particles called atomos?
The Greek word atomos, used by Democritus for the smallest particles of matter, means:
Which philosophers of ancient Greece believed that matter is continuous rather than composed of ultimate indivisible particles?
The ideas of Democritus about atoms were based on:
options: philosophical speculation rather than experimental evidence
the law of conservation of mass
questions.correctAnswer: philosophical speculation rather than experimental evidence

questions.question: Democritus's ideas about atoms gained broad acceptance for the first time in the year:
The scientist who developed an atomic theory that gained broad acceptance in 1808 was:
Dalton's atomic theory was based on which of the following pairs of scientific laws?
options: conservation of mass and definite proportions
questions.correctAnswer: conservation of mass and definite proportions

questions.question: The law stating that the total mass of the products equals the total mass of the reactants in a chemical reaction is the law of:
Water is 11.2% hydrogen and 88.8% oxygen by mass. The mass of hydrogen in 18.0 g of water is:
Regardless of its source, water is always 11.2% hydrogen and 88.8% oxygen by mass. This illustrates the law of:
The law of multiple proportions states that when two elements form a series of compounds, the masses of one element that combine with a fixed mass of the other are in the ratio of:
The masses of nitrogen that combine with 1 g of oxygen in three compounds were 1.750 g, 0.8750 g, and 0.4375 g. These masses are in the ratio:
Using the law of definite proportions, decomposing 1.00 g of water produces:
options: 0.112 g of hydrogen and 0.888 g of oxygen
0.888 g of hydrogen and 0.112 g of oxygen
0.056 g of hydrogen and 0.944 g of oxygen
0.500 g of hydrogen and 0.500 g of oxygen
questions.correctAnswer: 0.112 g of hydrogen and 0.888 g of oxygen

questions.question: How many postulates does Dalton's atomic theory contain?
Which of the following is one of the postulates of Dalton's atomic theory?
options: matter is composed of tiny, indivisible particles called atoms
atoms contain electrons, protons, and neutrons
atoms of the same element may have different masses
energy is emitted in discrete quanta
questions.correctAnswer: matter is composed of tiny, indivisible particles called atoms

questions.question: In Dalton's atomic theory, atoms of the same element are:
options: capable of being divided into smaller particles

questions.question: According to Dalton's atomic theory, atoms of different elements combine to form compounds in:
Dalton's atomic theory explains the law of conservation of mass by stating that in a chemical reaction atoms are:
The modern atomic theory is generally said to begin with:
Dalton's work was mainly focused on:
options: the chemistry of how atoms combine to form new compounds
questions.correctAnswer: the chemistry of how atoms combine to form new compounds

questions.question: The modern theory about the physical structure of atoms began when J.J. Thomson discovered which particle in 1897?
The discovery of isotopes showed that atoms of the same element can differ in their:
Which postulate of Dalton's atomic theory is inconsistent with the existence of isotopes?
options: all atoms of the same element are identical in mass and properties
atoms combine in simple whole-number ratios
questions.correctAnswer: all atoms of the same element are identical in mass and properties

questions.question: Which idea from Dalton's atomic theory continues to have significance in the modern atomic theory?
options: atoms of an element are identical in mass
the atom has no internal structure
